annotations.title: Design a parametric part with the AI CAD agent

description: For mechanical / functional parts with exact dimensions — brackets, enclosures, adapters, gears, bins, knobs, mounts — open PrintPal's AI CAD agent with a ready-to-run brief. The agent writes editable OpenSCAD with parameter sliders, live 3D preview and STL/3MF/STEP export. This tool improves the user's description into a precise CAD brief (dimensions, tolerances, mounting, print orientation) and returns the link; the user clicks it to generate.

description.description: What the part is and what it must fit/do.

dimensions.description: Known dimensions in mm, e.g. "60 x 40 x 20 mm, M3 holes 50 mm apart".

material.description: Intended filament (affects tolerances), e.g. PLA, PETG, TPU.
